acceptance: The PR's own CI fast-tier run is back in the pre-incident range: test-phase time (pytest total minus collection) within 5% of a pre-incident run with similar collection time (pre-incident pytest totals 328-552 s across runs 40143597290, 40143651006, 40139142059, 40142795657, 40145835140; e.g. 40143651006 collection 60.4 s, test phase 346.6 s), with the run id and summary line recorded; medium shards pass

context: Fix in progress on branch fix/chdb-guard-only-where-used. Source: CI time-regression incident 2026-10-25.
description: PR #3423 added tests/conftest.py _chdb_connections_closed_after_module (autouse, module scope), which calls chdb_open_connection_error() and opens a chDB probe session after every test module. The fast-tier pytest time went from 327.81 s (run 40143597290) to 1041.10 s (run 40195371347), making the fast job the PR critical path (about 12 to 20+ min). Fix: probe only modules that imported or used chDB, keeping the leak detection for modules that did.
